about.text: Shrikhand is a sweet dish of strained yoghurt, sugar, saffron and cardamom from Gujarat and Maharashtra, chilled and often topped with nuts. The BIS standard calls for at least 58 % total solids.

facts.v: Indian standard (BIS): protein at least 10.5 % of dry matter; sucrose at most 72.5 % of dry matter; acidity at most 1.4 % lactic acid
Shrikhand concentrated further in an open pan over fire to a hard mass: 5-6 % moisture, 63-65 % sugar
